payload.core_composition_summary: Sorting with custom key is the sole algorithmic mechanism; no coordinated multi-mechanism composition.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts vaulters using a custom key that encodes all ranking criteria (highest height, fewest attempts at that height, then total misses). It then iterates over the sorted list to extract the top 3 with tie labeling. No other algorithmic data structures or coordinated mechanisms are employed.
